objectives.en: Name the elements of xylem and phloem
Distinguish protoxylem and metaxylem, endarch and exarch
Compare phloem of angiosperms and gymnosperms

narration.en: A coconut tree lifts water more than 20 metres to its leaves and sends sugar all the way back down to its roots. It needs two separate pipelines.
narration.kn: ತೆಂಗಿನ ಮರ 20 ಮೀಟರ್‌ಗಿಂತ ಎತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ ನೀರನ್ನು ಎಳೆದು, ಸಕ್ಕರೆಯನ್ನು ಬೇರುಗಳವರೆಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕೊಳವೆಮಾರ್ಗಗಳು ಬೇಕು.

body.en: Xylem conducts water and minerals from the roots to the stem and leaves, and gives mechanical strength. It has four elements: tracheids, vessels, xylem fibres and xylem parenchyma. Tracheids and vessels are dead, lignified and tube-like. Vessels are characteristic of angiosperms; gymnosperms lack vessels. Xylem parenchyma is the only living element and stores food.
body.kn: ದಾರು ಬೇರಿನಿಂದ ನೀರು ಮತ್ತು ಖನಿಜಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ಘಟಕಗಳು: ಟ್ರೇಕಿಡ್, ನಾಳ (ವೆಸೆಲ್), ದಾರು ನಾರು, ದಾರು ಪ್ಯಾರೆಂಕೈಮಾ. ನಾಳಗಳು ಆವೃತಬೀಜಿಗಳ ವಿಶೇಷ; ಅನಾವೃತಬೀಜಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲ.

title.en: On the board: Complex tissues: xylem and phloem

say.en: Xylem carries water and minerals upwards through vessels and tracheids, which are dead.
Phloem carries food. Sieve tubes have sieve plates; a companion cell beside each controls it.
Phloem moves food from the leaves to other parts. Gymnosperms have no vessels and no companion cells.
Protoxylem forms first. In a stem it lies towards the pith: endarch.
In a root protoxylem lies towards the outside: exarch.

body.en: The first-formed xylem elements are protoxylem and the later ones metaxylem. In stems the protoxylem lies towards the centre (pith) and the metaxylem towards the periphery: this is endarch. In roots the protoxylem lies towards the periphery and the metaxylem towards the centre: this is exarch.
body.kn: ಮೊದಲು ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ದಾರು ಪ್ರೋಟೋಕ್ಸೈಲಮ್, ನಂತರದ್ದು ಮೆಟಾಕ್ಸೈಲಮ್. ಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೋಟೋಕ್ಸೈಲಮ್ ಮಧ್ಯದ ಕಡೆ (ಎಂಡಾರ್ಕ್); ಬೇರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊರಗಿನ ಕಡೆ (ಎಕ್ಸಾರ್ಕ್).

narration.en: The first-formed xylem elements are protoxylem and the later ones metaxylem. In stems the protoxylem lies towards the centre (pith) and the metaxylem towards the periphery: this is endarch. In roots the protoxylem lies towards the periphery and the metaxylem towards the centre: this is exarch.
narration.kn: ಮೊದಲು ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ದಾರು ಪ್ರೋಟೋಕ್ಸೈಲಮ್, ನಂತರದ್ದು ಮೆಟಾಕ್ಸೈಲಮ್. ಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೋಟೋಕ್ಸೈಲಮ್ ಮಧ್ಯದ ಕಡೆ (ಎಂಡಾರ್ಕ್); ಬೇರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊರಗಿನ ಕಡೆ (ಎಕ್ಸಾರ್ಕ್).

body.en: Phloem carries food, generally from the leaves to other parts. In angiosperms it has sieve tube elements, companion cells, phloem parenchyma and phloem fibres. A mature sieve tube element has a peripheral cytoplasm and a large vacuole but no nucleus, and its functions are controlled by the companion cell beside it. Gymnosperms have albuminous cells and sieve cells and lack sieve tubes and companion cells. Phloem fibres (bast fibres) are the only dead element of phloem, and phloem parenchyma is absent in most monocots.
body.kn: ಅನ್ನನಾಳ ಆಹಾರ ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆವೃತಬೀಜಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜರಡಿ ನಳಿಕೆ, ಸಹಚರ ಕೋಶ, ಅನ್ನನಾಳ ಪ್ಯಾರೆಂಕೈಮಾ, ಅನ್ನನಾಳ ನಾರು. ಪಕ್ವ ಜರಡಿ ನಳಿಕೆಗೆ ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರ ಇಲ್ಲ; ಸಹಚರ ಕೋಶ ಅದನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Gymnosperms: sieve cells and albuminous cells
Phloem fibres: the only dead phloem element

problem.en: A section shows xylem in which the narrow first-formed elements are near the pith and the wider later ones near the outside. Is this a root or a stem? Explain.

steps.en: First-formed narrow elements are protoxylem; wider later ones are metaxylem.
Protoxylem towards the centre (pith) and metaxylem outside is the endarch condition.
Endarch xylem is found in stems; roots are exarch.

answer.en: A stem, because the xylem is endarch
